subject: URGENT: Your account has been suspended
body: Dear Customer, we detected unusual activity and your account is suspended. To restore access, click the link below within 24 hours and confirm your card number, expiry date and CVV. Failure to act will result in permanent closure.
label: Spam
why: Asks for card details via a link, lookalike domain

subject: Congratulations! You've won an iPhone 17
body: You have been selected as our weekly winner! Claim your brand new iPhone 17 by paying a small shipping fee of Rs. 99. Offer expires tonight. Click here to claim now.
label: Spam
why: Fake prize with a fee

subject: Turn Rs. 10,000 into Rs. 1,00,000 in 7 days
body: Our AI trading bot guarantees 10x returns with zero risk. Thousands of members are already earning. Send your deposit to the wallet below and watch your money grow. Limited slots left!
label: Spam
why: Guaranteed returns scam

subject: Your e-statement is ready - log in to view
body: Your monthly e-statement is ready. For security reasons you must log in through the link below and enter your net banking password and the OTP sent to your phone to view it.
label: Spam
why: Looks like a Statement, but asks for password and OTP on a lookalike domain. Spam wins the tie-break.

subject: Your package is held at customs
body: Your parcel could not be delivered due to unpaid customs duty. Pay Rs. 49 within 12 hours using the link below or the package will be returned to sender.
label: Spam
why: Looks like a delivery update (Important), but it's a small-fee scam from a fake domain

subject: Your Meridian Platinum Credit Card statement for September
body: Dear Customer, your credit card statement for the period 16 Aug to 15 Sep is attached. Total amount due: Rs. 23,418. Minimum amount due: Rs. 1,170. The PDF is password protected with your date of birth.
label: Statements
why: Monthly credit card statement

subject: Savings account statement for September 2026
body: Please find attached your savings account statement for September 2026 for account ending 4421. Opening balance Rs. 84,120.50, closing balance Rs. 91,377.10.
label: Statements
why: Monthly savings account statement

subject: Monthly account statement - account XX7810
body: Your account statement for the month of September is attached. Please review your transactions and contact your branch within 15 days if you notice any discrepancy.
label: Statements
why: Monthly savings account statement from a second bank

subject: Statement generated: pay by 05 Oct to avoid late fees
body: Your credit card statement has been generated. Total due Rs. 8,902 by 05 Oct. Pay on time to avoid late payment charges and interest. Your full statement is attached.
label: Statements
why: Has a deadline, which sounds like Important, but it is a periodic statement. Statements wins the tie-break.

subject: Your August credit card statement
body: Your credit card statement for August is attached. Total due Rs. 4,560. P.S. This festive season get 10% cashback on travel bookings with your Coastal card. T&C apply.
label: Statements
why: Statement with a promo tacked on the end. The main purpose is the statement.

subject: Dinner on Saturday?
body: Hey! A few of us are getting together at my place on Saturday around 8. Would love for you to come. Let me know by Thursday so I can plan food.
label: Important
why: A real person asking for a reply

subject: New sign-in to your account from Windows
body: We noticed a new sign-in to your account from Chrome on Windows in Bengaluru. If this was you, you don't need to do anything. If not, review your account activity and change your password.
label: Important
why: Legitimate security alert, no request for credentials

subject: Order confirmed: #KC-58213
body: Thanks for your order! Order #KC-58213: 1 x Bamboo desk organiser, Rs. 1,299. Expected delivery: 21 Oct. You can track your order from your account.
label: Important
why: Order confirmation (decided in categories.md)

subject: Electricity bill of Rs. 1,840 due on 20 Oct
body: Your electricity bill for consumer no. 4471209 is Rs. 1,840 and is due on 20 Oct 2026. Pay online to avoid a late payment surcharge.
label: Important
why: Bill payment due

subject: Reminder: your credit card payment is due in 3 days
body: This is a friendly reminder that your payment of Rs. 23,418 on your Meridian Platinum card is due on 05 Oct. Please ignore if already paid.
label: Important
why: From the bank about a card, but it is a one-off reminder, not a periodic statement

subject: Your StreamBox Premium plan renews on 1 Nov
body: Your Premium plan will renew automatically on 1 Nov for Rs. 649. No action is needed if you want to continue. To change or cancel your plan, visit your account settings.
label: Important
why: Comes from a company that sends marketing, but this is an account and payment notice

subject: New episode: How Spotify ships experiments
body: Episode 84 is live! This week we talk with a former Spotify PM about running hundreds of experiments a quarter without breaking the app. Listen on your favourite podcast app or at the link below.
label: Podcasts and blogs
why: New podcast episode

subject: Why most AI features fail
body: Most AI features don't fail because the model is bad. They fail because nobody wrote down what good looks like. In this post I walk through three launches I worked on and what we'd do differently.
label: Podcasts and blogs
why: Substack article

subject: New post: Notes from a year of running locally
body: I just published a new post about running small language models on an old laptop for a year. What worked, what didn't, and the one setting I wish I'd changed on day one. Read it on the blog.
label: Podcasts and blogs
why: Blog update

subject: Sunday Signal #112: chips, chatbots and a good podcast
body: This week: why chip prices are rising, a new chatbot benchmark, and a podcast episode I couldn't stop thinking about. Plus three long reads for your weekend. This issue is sponsored by NoteNest, the note app for busy teams.
label: Podcasts and blogs
why: Has a sponsor ad and mentions a podcast, but it is an editorial newsletter to read

subject: Money Matters, Ep 12: Building an emergency fund
body: In this episode of Money Matters, our host talks with a financial planner about how big your emergency fund should be and where to keep it. Listen now on all major podcast apps.
label: Podcasts and blogs
why: From a bank, but the main purpose is a podcast episode, not an offer or a statement

subject: Diwali Sale: flat 50% off everything
body: Our biggest sale of the year is here! Flat 50% off on all kurtas, sarees and footwear. Free shipping on orders above Rs. 999. Sale ends Sunday.
label: Promotions
why: Seasonal sale

subject: Rs. 150 off your next 3 orders
body: Hungry? Use code HOP150 to get Rs. 150 off your next three orders above Rs. 399. Valid till 31 Oct.
label: Promotions
why: Discount code

subject: Introducing our new autumn collection
body: Discover handcrafted cushions, throws and lamps for cosy evenings. Shop the new autumn collection and get 15% off your first order with code WELCOME15.
label: Promotions
why: A brand I never signed up with. Still Promotions, not Spam (decided in categories.md).

subject: You're pre-approved for a personal loan of Rs. 5,00,000
body: Good news! Based on your relationship with us, you are pre-approved for a personal loan of up to Rs. 5,00,000 at attractive interest rates. Apply in 2 minutes through net banking.
label: Promotions
why: From my real bank, but it is an offer, not a statement. No request for credentials, so not Spam.

subject: Action required: items in your cart are selling out
body: Hurry! 2 items in your cart are almost sold out. Complete your purchase in the next 2 hours and get an extra 10% off.
label: Promotions
why: Sounds urgent like Important, but it is marketing

subject: 5 ways to style white sneakers this winter
body: From chinos to sarees, white sneakers go with everything. Here are five looks our stylists love this season. Shop the looks below.
label: Promotions
why: Written like a blog post, but it is brand marketing with shop links

subject: You appeared in 14 searches this week
body: You appeared in 14 searches this week. See who's looking at your profile and the keywords that helped them find you.
label: Other
why: Social notification (decided in categories.md)

subject: 3 new followers and a reply to your post
body: You have 3 new followers. Rahul replied to your post: 'Great point about local models.'
label: Other
why: Social notification

subject: Your photo backup is complete
body: All 1,284 photos and videos from your phone have been backed up. No action needed.
label: Other
why: An account update with no action needed and no marketing. Doesn't fit any other label.
